tests.label: Standing launch
tests.why: launch → mass, diff center split, accel spin

tests.label: Full gear ladder
tests.why: WOT time in every gear → gearing tab

tests.why: hold top gear WOT 5 s → drag / final drive

turns.note: 181 turns on record · 2 laps — drive 1 more to confirm the turn count · C2, C4, C61, C73, C154 often split into several detections (taken inconsistently)

2544|2|10|800.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
2544|2|10|800.evidence: 96/186 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

2544|2|10|800.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
2544|2|10|800.evidence: USI median +0.335 over 186 corners (119 understeer, 9 mid-corner front reds)

2544|2|10|800.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
2544|2|10|800.evidence: median peak rear slip 19.70; 4/4 launches spun

2544|2|10|800.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
2544|2|10|800.evidence: 3300 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

2544|2|10|800.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 56 stops (4 both-axle, 0 front-first, 4 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.46) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
